findings.summary: The Timedelta row of the type table is a cut-off fragment.

findings.evidence: "NaT propagates through arithmetic; most aggregations skip it"
findings.fix: Split into two bullets: one for arithmetic propagation, one for aggregations skipping NaT.

findings.summary: The slicing code comes before the idea behind it, and the section mixes slicing with grouping keys.
findings.evidence: "3. Slicing and grouping keys" opens straight with df.loc['2024'] ... and only afterwards says "sorted DatetimeIndex; both ends inclusive"
findings.fix: Put the one-line rule first (partial strings slice a sorted DatetimeIndex, both ends inclusive), then the code. Split grouping keys and between_time into their own section.

findings.summary: The rule for date_range arguments is imprecise and could be misread.
findings.evidence: "Give any two of start, end, periods"
findings.fix: Say that date_range needs three of start, end, periods and freq, and that freq defaults to 'D'.

findings.summary: The shift and pct_change code is shown before its one-line idea, and the lag, lead and change calls are only comments.
findings.evidence: "3. Lag, lead, change" goes straight to the code block, and the summary "s.pct_change() == s / s.shift(1) - 1, first row NaN" comes after it.
findings.fix: Open with the one-line idea (shift moves values, pct_change is a ratio, diff is a difference), and show the code after it. Alternatively use a Call | Gives table like the cheat sheet.

findings.summary: Two lines on the page contradict each other about calling tz_localize on aware data.
findings.evidence: "tz_localize on aware data raises too" versus the table row "tz_localize(None) | aware | strips the zone"
findings.fix: Reword to "tz_localize('zone') on aware data raises TypeError; only tz_localize(None) works on aware data", or fold both cases into the table.

findings.summary: The Change and Zones table breaks its two-column shape because the tz rows are split across lines.
findings.evidence: "tz_localize('Asia/Kolkata')" and "naive to aware" sit on separate lines under the "Call | Gives" table, as do "tz_convert('UTC')" and "same instant".
findings.fix: Write them as table rows: "tz_localize('Asia/Kolkata') | naive to aware" and "tz_convert('UTC') | same instant".
